meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Daily inter-bank forex rates, USD/INR (DBIE report 691)
meta.coverage: The dollar's price in the inter-bank market each day: open, high, low, close, beside the reference rate
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 691, rupees per US dollar, trading days since August 2000. Days the table records as 0 (no quote) and one misprint (3,355.73) are left empty and disclosed per series.
